title: Standing on FURM ground - A framework for evaluating Fair, Useful, and Reliable AI Models in healthcare systems
benchmark_measurement: The framework presented in the paper did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It is a framework (FURM) designed to evaluate AI models in healthcare settings on the dimensions of fairness, usefulness, and reliability.
models_tested: AI model for Screening for Peripheral Arterial Disease (PAD)
AI model for Estimating Coronary Artery Calcium (CAC) from Computed Tomography (CT) Scans
AI model for Avoiding Unplanned Emergency Department (ED) Visits by Oncology Patients
AI model for Screening for ST-elevation Myocardial Infarction (STEMI) in the ED
AI model for Improving Documentation and Coding for Inpatient Care
AI model for Identifying Hospital-Acquired Sepsis
base_benchmarks: Key Decision Points developed by the Health AI partnership
Coalition for Health AI's Blueprint for Trustworthy AI Implementation Guidance and Assurance for Healthcare
Duke Algorithm-Based Clinical Decision Support (ABCDS) Oversight framework
findings: The paper does not address religion, faith, or religious groups, and therefore has no findings on this topic.
references: Huang F, Blaschke S, Lucas H. Beyond pilotitis: taking digital health interventions to the national level in China and Uganda. Global Health 2017;13(1):49.
